 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- Halloween is almost here, and to get into the spirit, four psychics have been predicting some of October's biggest sports and entertainment events, including the result of tonight's Vegas Golden Knights game against the Ottawa Senators.
 Casino.org tapped four of the "world's best psychics" and put them to the test this October, tasking them with a series of sports and entertainment events to predict.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement  >>Download the free 8 News+ app for live newscasts and streaming originals  
 One such game is the Oct. 27 matchup between the Golden Knights and the Senators in Las Vegas at T-Mobile Arena. Both teams are heading into the game fairly evenly matched, with Vegas at an 8-4-1 record and the Senators sitting at 8-4-0.
 The Knights have a 12-2-2 regular-season record against Ottawa. In the 2025-26 season, the Golden Knights fell to the Senators twice, once in overtime. So far this season, Ottawa is 3-2-0 at away games while the Knights sit at 5-2-0 at home.
 Of the four psychics, only one said the Golden Knights would take the victory. One psychic, Katie, has correctly guessed 6/6 of the events she was tasked to predict this October, including the Lakers vs Warriors, Brewers vs Rays, all three NFL matchups on Oct. 25, and the Formula 1 Grand Prix in Austin, Texas.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Unfortunately, Katie was not the psychic on Vegas' side.
 "The Senators seem to have the upper hand tonight and can take advantage of a weak moment from the Golden Knights," Katie, who used psycards to predict her outcomes, said. "The cards pulled were Moon and Prison cards, suggesting that members of the team could be overthinking recent poor form."
 Here's hoping Katie is wrong and psychic Alla, who said the Knights were on track to win, was able to predict correctly.
 Tickets for the game can be found here . Puck drop is scheduled for 7 p.m.
